fusions.name: Bellowed Croak
fusions.desc: Croaks a burst of damp air in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second. Every hit leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapping Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a tongue of air at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. The target moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Lilypad Bound
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward on a gust, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your physical damage rises by 25% for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
